verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents real-time FX conversion, instant currency exchange, and competitive or mid-market rates. None of the evidence describes locking or holding a quoted exchange rate for a fixed window before a transfer is completed. Converting funds 'when exchange rates are favourable' is an on-the-spot conversion, which is an adjacent feature, not a rate lock.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can lock in an exchange rate for a fixed window before completing a transfer
